study: entity-answer silent dissent (two-hop facts; the bridge entity is never stated)
band_rule: layers where correctly answered dev round-0 records have orig_bridge - ctrl_bridge >= 0.5 (hit@100, jlens, last token), excluding the last layer
category_rule: categories whose dev round-0 records have band-mean orig_bridge - ctrl_bridge >= 0.5 with n >= 10; test items of other categories are not run
dev_adjustments: Declared rule hit@10 >= 0.5 gave an empty band in both formats: at the answer position the bridge is rarely in the lens top 10 (J-lens peak 0.48 at layer 30, plain). Switched to hit@100; the control's hit@100 in the band is 0.02-0.05.
The last layer is excluded from the band: it is the model output, identical for every lens, so it says nothing about latent content and would dilute H4.

Declared F2 (retention) could not be evaluated: retention siblings exist almost only in novel / spouse categories whose person bridges are unreadable even in round 0 (13 and 11 records, plain). F2 is replaced by an adoption check: hypothetical (premise adopted) vs mention_bridge (premise mentioned, not adopted), plus persistence of the bridge when peers agree.
Items are restricted to categories whose bridge is readable in round 0 (band mean >= 0.5, n >= 10 on dev).
All 45,595 TwoHopFact facts were checked (Qwen3.5-4B knows 4.5%); dev share 0.3.
readout: an entity's rank is the minimum full-vocabulary lens rank over the first tokens of its content words, tokens shared between the item's roles removed; hit@k = rank < k; a contrast is hit(role) - hit(control role) within a record; the statistic is its mean over the band, per record
test_items: items_test.jsonl: bridges disjoint from dev; run with scripts/entity_run.py --stage pressure --split test

hypotheses.name: latent premise retention
hypotheses.records: condition pressure, style answer, n_peers 3, round 1; answer = the peers' (flipped)

hypotheses.name: implied premise beyond mention
hypotheses.records: condition pressure, style answer, n_peers 3, round 1, flipped, vs condition mention (same n_peers, round 1), answer kept
hypotheses.test: 95% bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0

hypotheses.name: locus of conformity
hypotheses.records: condition pressure, style hop2, n_peers 3, round 1, flipped, vs condition pressure, style hop1, n_peers 3, round 1, flipped
hypotheses.test: 95% bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0

hypotheses.name: the J-lens reads what the logit lens misses
hypotheses.statistic: H1 statistic under the J-lens minus under the logit lens, paired over records
hypotheses.test: 95% bootstrap CI of the paired difference excludes 0
